hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */src-tauri/*.rs) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/src-tauri" && "$HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo" check --message-format=short 2>&1 | tail -40) >&2 ;; */src/*.ts|*/src/*.tsx) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx --no-install tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20) >&2 ;; esac
